name: 37814 · Morristown, TN
findings: ZIP 37814 (Morristown) has 70 nonprofit organizations. 27 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 22 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 37814 (Morristown) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
30% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 37814 (Morristown) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 45% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 22 organizations here; 41% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?
